player_intent: Changing direction while standing or crouched continues the current gait cycle instead of visibly restarting the animation from its first frame.
acceptance_rule: Standing and crouched lateral points reuse their posture-matched forward gait source with bounded hip yaw, both BlendSpace2D nodes use Cyclic Mutable synchronization, and a forward-to-right switch advances normalized phase by more than 0.001 and less than 0.08 in one physics frame. Opposing A/D and W/S direction changes reach at least 0.99 logical and rendered target alignment within one second at 30, 60, and 120 Hz. Standing heading changes stay below 45 degrees per update; crouch crossfades through a shared center gait with coordinate steps below 0.5 and an advancing gait clock. See crouch_strafe_height_continuity for live action and actual-playhead coverage.

translation_card.player_intent: Reversing movement while standing or crouched turns the displayed gait toward the new input without restarting its cycle.
translation_card.acceptance_rule: All 24 opposing-direction stance and frame-rate cases converge within one second while gait phase continues.
translation_card.must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement, SOCOM camera and reticle, server weapons and damage, weapon contacts, and animation action ownership.
translation_card.focused_proof: tools/directional_locomotion_phase_regression.gd fails all 24 opposing cases with normalized vector lerp and passes with heading interpolation; canonical rendered reversal and foot-contact quality still require the separate visual audit.

nodes.role: Blends logical movement directions on one normalized gait clock while leaving authoritative movement unchanged.
Resolves left and right logical slots to one forward source take plus a bounded visual hip-yaw offset.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement direction, velocity, speed, collision, and root transform
SOCOM camera, reticle, and aim-intent ownership
server weapon, shot, damage, reload, and multiplayer authority
upper-body weapon contacts, shoulder-square constraints, and action animation ownership
visual_check: In res://main.tscn, hold forward and switch directly to left or right while standing, then repeat crouched. Also reverse A to D, D to A, W to S, and S to W after each direction has settled. Confirm the gait turns with the new input without restarting. Planted-foot sliding and pose-pop quality remain a separate failing baseline gate and are not certified by this contract.

system_delta.reason: Keep cyclic synchronization, shared forward aliases and response rates. Standing uses shortest-angle easing. The later crouch-height pass uses unnormalized blend-coordinate easing through a forward center node; unlike the old normalized chord, it crosses zero without becoming stuck. The actual crouch playhead/action path is separately covered by crouch_strafe_height_continuity. General planted-foot quality is not certified here.

current.system: Canonical cyclic graph normalizes each direction lerp, trapping exact opposing vectors at their old direction

candidate.system: The same graph eases direction headings with lerp_angle, preserves the shared gait clock, and tests all cardinal reversals across both stances and three frame rates
